works.body:
Hello! Can you draw my death god character "Thana"? She uses a scythe so if you could include one in the picture that would be amazing! She has a more serious demeanor and strictly sticks to doing her work. She rarely smiles but is a very graceful person.
https://sta.sh/2195ok9ama4g?edit=1
Please follow the hairstyle in this reference https://sta.sh/01mkw696cz8q
For her horns and hair accessories you can pick whichever picture to reference. 
https://sta.sh/027gmsejqo2a is her main outfit reference but if it is confusing feel free to adjust things to your liking.
If possible, please give me two files, one with the addressee to "Whiteislande" (my username) and the other to "Whitney"?
I will leave the pose and composition up to you :)
Thank you for your consideration!
